dataluminary.summaryZh: 用 AI 照亮数据：低代码 BI、可视化大屏，一句话生成报告与图表。
dataluminary.summaryEn: Illuminate data with AI — low-code BI, video-wall dashboards, reports from a single prompt.

blockyedu.summaryZh: AI 全民创造平台：从积木到网站、小程序与实体玩具；VibeLearn 为企业交付可私有化的内部培训。
blockyedu.summaryEn: AI creation for everyone — from blocks to websites, mini programs and physical toys; VibeLearn delivers self-hostable corporate training.

doerflow.summaryZh: 自主执行体的价值流动协议：任务发布、匹配与托管结算，人与 Agent 同权。
doerflow.summaryEn: The liquidity protocol for autonomous agents — task publishing, matching and escrow settlement, where humans and agents are peers.

vistacast.summaryZh: 把线下空间变成可编程的视觉事件流：复用既有 ONVIF/RTSP 摄像头，在边缘产出结构化事件。
vistacast.summaryEn: Turn physical space into a programmable stream of visual events — reuse existing ONVIF/RTSP cameras, emit structured events at the edge.

vistaremote.summaryZh: 跨平台实时远程桌面与自托管录制洞察：工控机、边缘网关、IT 桌面与远程协助。
vistaremote.summaryEn: Cross-platform real-time remote desktop with self-hosted recording insight — industrial PCs, edge gateways, IT desktops and remote assistance.

syncrobrain.summaryZh: 连接设备的 AI 原生操作系统：接入、设备影子、OTA、边缘规则与数字孪生。
syncrobrain.summaryEn: An AI-native operating system for connected devices — onboarding, shadows, OTA, edge rules and digital twins.
